audit_items.proof_trace: Property holds because every valuation function (collaterals_usd_for_liquidation, debts_value_usd_for_liquidation, liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens, debts_value_usd_non_liquidation, collaterals_usd_non_liquidation) calls get_price/get_price_with_check/get_spot_price, all of which invoke check_price that asserts age <= price_delay_tolerance_ms and aborts with oracle_stale_price_error() if the stored price is stale. No direct access to the raw XOracle.price() accessor is made from the market module; all price reads are routed through the staleness-enforcing user_oracle functions.
